answer: Gate issuance behind a convex permit curve plus a probation voyage. The permit for the n-th identity costs (n/10000)^2 credits, and every buyer stakes one onyx per permit inside a basalt record no clone can rewrite. Staked onyx returns only after the identity finishes its voyage: ten epochs of attested work, zero slashes. An attacker who owns n voyage clones pays n^3/(3e8) credits before one coin returns; an honest newcomer pays one permit and ten epochs of patience - cost grows super-linearly in clone count and cannot be pooled, since probation demands attested work from non-kin peers.
